_comment: CANDIDATE image facts for SkyPilot 0.12.3, recorded by work package S03 of the
2026-09-21 security scan (issue #5602) as the handoff artifact for the re-pin owner (S21).
THIS FILE IS NOT LIVE. It is the exact content that
modules/domain-apps/superplane/tests/skypilot_image_facts.json must contain IF AND ONLY IF
releases/superplane.lock.yaml is re-pinned to the digest below. Both changes have to land
together: test_skypilot_startup_contract.py asserts the lock digest equals this file's
image_index_digest, so applying one without the other fails that test by design.
Every digest below was fetched and hashed rather than copied, using the same method the
live facts file documents: the image index body hashes to image_index_digest, the amd64
manifest body hashes to amd64_manifest_digest, and the config blob body hashes to
config_blob_digest. `config` is that blob's `.config` object verbatim. The method was
validated by re-deriving the currently recorded 0.12.0 values with the same commands and
getting byte-identical results.
`etc_passwd_uids` and `home_entries` come from downloading all 12 amd64 layers (each
verified against its manifest digest), extracting every one, and reading the last
/etc/passwd to win (layer 6 in this image, layer 5 in 0.12.0), plus scanning all layers
for any path under home/. As in 0.12.0 there is no uid 1000, and the only home/ path is
the bare directory with no entry inside it, which is why the Deployment must still set
HOME explicitly — see test_skypilot_startup_contract.py.
WHY 0.12.3: it clears two of the five high findings this work package owns, at their
bundled locations — cryptography 43.0.3 -> 46.0.5, and jackson-core 2.16.1 -> 2.18.6
inside ray/jars/ray_dist.jar via ray 2.54.0 -> 2.55.1. It is a patch release inside the
0.12.x line the controller was written against, and all of the server/client contract
values below were re-read from the skypilot==0.12.3 wheel and are unchanged from 0.12.0.
See S03-disposition.md for the per-finding evidence and for the two findings that survive.
TO RE-VERIFY (needs network; the tests do not):
TOK=$(curl -s 'https://auth.docker.io/token?service=registry.docker.io&scope=repository:berkeleyskypilot/skypilot:pull' | jq -r .token)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json' \
https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/berkeleyskypilot/skypilot/manifests/<image_index_digest> | sha256sum
The printed hash must equal image_index_digest's hex. Repeat for the manifest and blob.
Read from the skypilot==0.12.3 wheel — the same version this image installs — so the
manifest's command/args/env are checked against the code that will run, not against
an upstream doc or a controller-side constant.
Every value here was re-read for 0.12.3 and is identical to the recorded 0.12.0 value.
That is the compatibility evidence for the re-pin: no manifest change is required.
TO RE-VERIFY: pip download skypilot==0.12.3 --no-deps, unzip, and grep the cited
files. Each value below names its source path.
